industry.key: P. Energy, commodities and metals mining
industry.why: Overweight, carried. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: B now, A prior at the industry, with Downstream distribution A, Upstream A, Services D and Metals and mining F inside it. No Brent level reached the pack, so the condition (Brent under $85) is untested, and the undated headline that oil is dipping on peace hopes is noted, not acted on. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only): energy is still the hedge inside a European book against the shock that hurts everything else, and the hedge has not been needed for two weeks. Eight of the top 40 on the starting score are energy names, from 15 last week, as Neste and Galp left the Pool. Counter-case: the tilt scorecard's negative spreads are consistent with the Overweight having been paid already, and a ceasefire would take the premium out. To C if Brent is read under $85 or the industry's relative strength falls to C.

sector.key: P.3. Energy - services and engineering contractors
sector.why: Overweight, carried, with the disagreement widened. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-11-06 against 2026-09-04, not week on week: D now, C prior, so the market moved away from the row rather than towards it; the condition for A (relative strength leaving C upward with Sell-side Momentum turning up) is not met, and the condition for C (Brent under $85) could not be tested because no Brent level reached the pack and the only oil read is an undated headline that oil is dipping on peace hopes. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). Held on Kepler Cheuvreux's structural read of 29 October (Subsea7's vessels booked 18 to 24 months, pricing holding regardless of spot crude), a week old and not contradicted. Seven Pool names, SBM Offshore eighth on the starting score and marked leaving the Pool. Counter-case: a Ukraine ceasefire and a United States-China truce (FXStreet, 2 November) take the geopolitical premium out of crude, and services are the most operationally geared end of energy. To C if Brent is read under $85 or relative strength falls to F; to A only with relative strength back at B.

geography.why: Overweight, carried; the condition (back to C if Brent falls under $85 or Oslo's leadership reverses for four weeks) could not be tested: no Brent level reached the pack, the only oil read is an undated headline that oil is dipping on peace hopes, and Oslo was not read. Component 1 regime, 6-Nov-26 (risk-off beneath an index at its high, now present in Europe's own prices: the STOXX Europe 600 0.9% from its 52-week high with the share of stocks above the 100, 150 and 200-day averages at or below the tenth percentile of near-high days since 2006, defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows, breadth recovering for a second week; the causes, inflation, rates, yields, credit and the consumer, unread this week because the strategist and newsletter files did not reach the pack, so the credit-and-cost-of-debt read of 30-Oct-26 with the US ten-year above 5% is held one week stale; sources present 2026-W45, headline-only). Energy relative strength slipped to B from A at the industry with Upstream still A. Counter-case: this double counts the Energy rows for most of the 46 Norwegian stocks, and a Ukraine ceasefire takes the premium out of crude. Back to C if Brent is read under $85.
